build_gmm_model_selection: build a Gaussian Mixture Model selection pipeline using GridSearchCV with BIC scoring across covariance types and component counts
create_gmm_bic_score_function: create a BIC scoring function that returns negative BIC values for use with GridSearchCV maximization
test_gmm_best_estimator: test the best Gaussian Mixture Model estimator selected by GridSearchCV and retrieve its parameters
plot_gmm_bic_scores: plot BIC scores across different component counts and covariance types using seaborn bar charts
visualize_gmm_components: visualize selected GMM components with scatter plots and covariance ellipses using eigenvalue decomposition
